# incident.io — account brief

## Who

incident.io describes itself as "All-in-one incident management — Declare, run, and learn from incidents without leaving Slack. Incident management for teams that ship software." ([source](https://incident.io/)) Its GitHub org, incident-io, lists incident.io as its website. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io))

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is in incident-io/on-call-app. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/eas.json))
- `package.json` in that repo lists react-native 0.74.3. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/package.json))
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows`. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- The org has 38 public repos and 520 followers. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io))
- incident.io On-call has 3,100 App Store ratings. ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777))
- There have been 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days. ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777))
- An open issue reads "EAS build failing on iOS since Xcode 16 image update". ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214))
- An open issue reads "Track: upgrade to Expo SDK 53". ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198))
- incident.io is hiring for React Native: "incident.io | London, UK or Remote (UK) | Product Engineer, Mobile (React Native) | REMOTE | https://incident.io/careers" ([source](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45311640))

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@incident-io-maintainer-1), top contributor to incident-io/on-call-app with 174 commits; profile lists company "incident.io" and website https://incident.io. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-1))
- Maintainer Two (@incident-io-maintainer-2), top contributor with 92 commits; profile lists company "incident.io" and website https://incident.io. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-2))
- Maintainer Three (@incident-io-maintainer-3), top contributor with 45 commits; profile lists company "incident.io" and website https://incident.io. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-3))

The evidence does not list a role, title, or location for any of them beyond the company field.

## Why now

incident-io/on-call-app last pushed 2026-08-19 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app)), and the App Store listing shows 5 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)). The repo is on react-native 0.74.3 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/package.json)) with an open issue tracking an upgrade to Expo SDK 53 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)).

## Suggested opener

You have 174 commits in incident-io/on-call-app, which pushed as recently as 2026-08-19 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-1)) ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app)). Issue 214 in that repo says the EAS build has been failing on iOS since the Xcode 16 image update ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214)), and issue 198 tracks the move to Expo SDK 53 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)). With 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)), are those two blocking each other, or is the SDK upgrade waiting on the build image?
